purpose: Sources cited by approved_for_rollup enrichment submissions whose DOIs are NOT registered with the DOI handle registry (https://doi.org/api/handles/<doi> returns 404) and which resolve to no PubMed/PMC record. They must never be admitted to public/data/source-registry.json or public/data/enrichment-normalized.jsonl.
verificationMethod: DOI handle registry lookup plus PubMed ID conversion, 2026-09-06.

fabricated.structuralNote: Taylor & Francis DOIs use numeric journal codes (e.g. 10.1080/15569543.YYYY.NNNNN), never a journal abbreviation.
Wiley Phytotherapy Research is 10.1002/ptr.NNNN with no year segment; 'ptrr' is not a Wiley journal code.
Molecular Pharmaceutics is an ACS title (10.1021/acs.molpharmaceut.*), not an Elsevier j.* code.
Frontiers DOIs are 10.3389/fXXXX.YYYY.NNNNNN; 'nprev' is not a Frontiers journal code.
BMC DOIs are 10.1186/sNNNNN-YY-NNNNN-N; 'cpr.YYYY.NNNNN' is not a BMC pattern.
No Elsevier journal uses the 'j.mnp' code.

admissionRequirement: Admission requires a human to assign reliabilityTier and record reviewer/reviewedAt per schemas/source-registry.schema.json. Verification that a DOI exists is necessary but not sufficient. Where admitting a source would also clear the last automated gate on a high-stakes claim, the registry row additionally carries an editorialAdjudication hold, which rollupSourceEligibilityError enforces.
amendmentNote: Amended after commit 7ef8d71e6 admitted the nine verified sources. The section previously named verifiedRealButNotAdmitted asserted they were withheld, which stopped being true 35 minutes after this file was written.

retracted.note: Aged-garlic blood-pressure meta-analysis, retracted. Must not back canonical efficacy.
The retraction notice for PMID 39437887. A notice is not evidence and must not be cited as support.

verifiedReal.title: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis on the Survival of Cancer Patients Treated with a Fermented Viscum album L. Extract (Iscador)
verifiedReal.verificationNote: Real and entity-aligned (Viscum album = mistletoe). HIGH-STAKES: a supported_use/efficacy_signal for cancer survival is a YMYL editorial decision and must not be admitted mechanically. Design is systematic review / meta-analysis and must be recorded as such.

editorialAdjudication.reason: Cancer-survival efficacy from a contested, industry-adjacent Iscador literature is a YMYL editorial decision. Admitting the source made it citable; it does not authorize a mistletoe survival efficacy claim.
